prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1186; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving your insured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know as soon as possible.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please also disclose whether any excess or umbrella policies exist.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any electronic records, including telematics or dashcam footage. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and your compliance with these requests.
